title: A Socio-political history of Marathi Theatre, Vol 2

vibeProfile.oneLine: A socio-political history of Marathi theatre, volume two.

summary: The second volume of Makarand Sathe's monumental study continues his socio-political history of Marathi theatre, carrying the story through further decades of one of India's most vibrant and engaged theatrical traditions. It links the plays, playwrights and movements of the Marathi stage to the social and political life of their times. A pioneering, deeply researched scholarly work that reads theatre as both mirror and agent of Maharashtra's public world.
whyReadIt: The second volume of Sathe's pioneering socio-political history of Marathi theatre. Deeply researched.
